character_relation: Pip discovered it and lives by it
meaning: Cannot be contained; once a true force or path has formed, no cage, closed path, false convergence, enemy, world-condition, or broken system can honestly hold it.
usage_law: Use as a Pip-centered living word, not detached system jargon. It belongs first to Pip's no-path survival logic, sonomancy, Diamond pressure, Rolzen healing, Blood Cello endurance, and post-Diamond path-forging. Other characters may learn it from Pip or recognize it through him, but Pip is the origin-carrier/prover.
